PRODUCT MANAGER – NODA AI

Location: Austin, TX (Hybrid on-site, with up to 20% travel)
Clearance Requirement: U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain a security clearance




ABOUT NODA

NODA is a venture-backed technology company that is transforming how unmanned systems collaborate in complex, mission-critical environments. We are developing next-generation solutions that enable the autonomous orchestration of heterogeneous unmanned systems across air, sea, land, and space with vital applications in the defense, intelligence, and commercial sectors.

Our Product Managers drive the strategic vision and execution of groundbreaking autonomous orchestration solutions, shaping novel products from initial concept through customer delivery in one of technology's most innovative and impactful sectors.

Joining NODA means working on meaningful technology that pushes the boundaries of autonomy alongside a team that thrives on innovation, rapid iteration, and collaboration.




THE ROLE

We are seeking a talented Product Manager to help lead the development and delivery of our autonomous orchestration platform. This is an exceptional opportunity to build novel product features from the ground up, working directly with customers to define requirements and collaborating with engineering teams to deliver cutting-edge solutions that transform multi-domain autonomous operations. You'll own the full product lifecycle, from strategic planning and market analysis to feature development and customer success.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define and execute product strategy and roadmap for autonomous orchestration solutions

 - Work directly with defense, intelligence, and commercial customers to understand requirements and translate them into actionable product features

 - Collaborate closely with engineering teams to prioritize development efforts and ensure timely delivery of high-quality products

 - Lead cross-functional teams through the entire product development lifecycle, from concept to customer deployment

 - Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and inform product positioning

 - Develop go-to-market strategies and support business development efforts with technical product expertise

 - Manage product launches and coordinate with customers on successful deployment and integration

 - Gather and analyze user feedback to continuously improve product offerings and customer experience




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

 - 3+ years of product management experience leading hardware–software integrated products, with hands-on involvement in defining and delivering end-to-end systems spanning hardware, firmware, and software.

 - Strong understanding of how software, firmware, and hardware interact in real-world, production systems.

 - Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make sound, data-driven product decisions.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional and multi-stakeholder product development initiatives.

 - Due to the nature of the position, U.S. citizenship is required due to ITAR regulations, along with the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - MBA or advanced degree in relevant field

 - Previous military, government, or defense industry experience

 - Experience with autonomous systems, robotics, AI/ML, or related technologies

 - Background in both technical product management and product marketing

 - Existing security clearance

 - Experience working with DoD or intelligence community customers




SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES

 - Strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities

 - Customer-centric mindset with ability to translate user needs into product requirements

 - Technical acumen to work effectively with engineering teams and understand complex systems

 - Versatility to handle diverse responsibilities from technical specifications to marketing positioning

 - Adaptability and comfort working in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving startup environment

 - Passion for innovative technology that makes a meaningful impact




BENEFITS & PERKS

Our culture fosters collaboration, respect, and trust, empowering passionate people to do their best work. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career growth. In addition to an opportunity to take part in an innovative, collaborative and fast-growing business with a highly motivated and skilled team, we also take pride in taking care of our employees. Here are just a few ways that we show our appreciation:

 - We offer premium medical, dental, and vision coverage with zero paycheck premiums for you and your family

 - 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan to invest in your long-term retirement goals + Company match

 - Equity grants for new hires

 - Unlimited PTO

 - 11 Paid holidays

 - Extremely generous company holiday calendar, including a holiday hiatus in November, & December.

 - Generous Parental Leave

 - Military Leave for annual training or service requirements

 - FSA

 - DCFSA

 - HSA

 - Professional Development Opportunities

 - Access to One Medical https://www.onemedical.com/

 - Mental Health Resources: We provide free mental health resources 24/7 including therapy and more. Additional work-life services, such as free legal and financial support, are available to you as well.




GROWTH PATH AT NODA

As NODA continues to grow, there will be opportunities for Product Managers to advance into senior product leadership roles, expand into new market segments, or take on broader strategic responsibilities across the organization.

To conform to U.S. government export control regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or otherwise eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or U.S. Department of Commerce.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager – Autonomy
jobs.description:
SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER (AUTONOMY) – NODA AI

Location: Austin, TX (Hybrid on-site, with up to 10% travel)
Clearance Requirement: U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain a security clearance




ABOUT NODA

NODA is a Veteran-owned, venture-backed technology company that is transforming how unmanned systems collaborate in complex, mission-critical environments. We are developing next-generation solutions that enable the autonomous orchestration of heterogeneous unmanned systems across air, sea, land, and space with vital applications in the defense, intelligence, and commercial sectors.

Our Technical Program Managers serve as the connective tissue between engineering execution and program delivery, translating complex, multi-domain autonomy requirements into disciplined, on-time delivery.

Joining NODA means working on meaningful technology that pushes the boundaries of autonomy alongside a team that thrives on innovation, rapid iteration, and collaboration.




THE ROLE

As Senior Technical Program Manager for the Autonomy team, you own the day-to-day coordination fabric of the team: sprint ceremonies, cross-team dependencies, requirement intake and refinement, release coordination, and status reporting. Your requirement work centers on autonomy capabilities — perception, path planning, guidance/navigation/control (GNC), multi-agent and swarm coordination — so you need enough fluency in autonomy systems to translate dense technical and mission intent into clear, testable engineering requirements without leaning on the engineering leads to do that translation for you. Jira is your system of record and requirement management is your craft.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead requirement intake and refinement sessions for autonomy capabilities (perception, planning, GNC, multi-agent/swarm behaviors), translating product and mission intent into clear, testable, well-scoped engineering requirements and own associated acceptance criteria.

 - Maintain requirement traceability from initiative → epic → story → acceptance criteria so every unit of work maps to a stated need and a definition of done.

 - Enforce scope discipline through the release cycle; manage changes through an explicit intake and change-control process.

 - Keep initiative, epic, and story status current in Jira; own the blocked-initiative log and coordinate with Project Engineers on state transitions.

 - Enforce Jira hygiene conventions (fields, labels, components, definition-of-ready/done) so the tool remains a reliable system of record.

 - Own and run all Autonomy team sprint ceremonies — planning, standup, review, retro, and backlog refinement — including agenda prep, facilitation, follow-up notes, and action-item tracking.

 - Manage cross-team dependencies across Autonomy, Core, Systems, Solutions, and Release Engineering, surfacing and resolving them before issues become a blocker.

 - Produce concise, informative and audience relevant technical briefs to drive program forward.




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years of experience in technical program / project management for software or autonomy engineering teams.

 - Demonstrated mastery of requirement management — intake, refinement, traceability, and change control on complex programs.

 - Substantial hands-on experience with autonomy systems — e.g., unmanned/robotic vehicle platforms, perception, path planning, guidance/navigation/control (GNC), or multi-agent/swarm coordination — sufficient to engage directly with autonomy engineers and translate algorithm and systems-engineering concepts into structured requirements.

 - High Jira fluency, with the ability to configure dashboards, workflows and custom reports.

 - Excellent verbal and written communication; able to synthesize and decompose strategic vision into clear executable plans.

 - Experience standing up and driving adoption of new process framework / operating models from scratch.

 - Due to the nature of the position, U.S. citizenship is required due to ITAR regulations, along with the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Background in autonomy, robotics, aerospace, or defense programs — commercial UxS, military autonomy, or research environments.

 - Familiarity with simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), or field test environments used to validate autonomous systems.

 - Agile or Project Management certifications such as SAFe, Scrum Alliance, PMP, Lean Six Sigma.

 - Experience in product management, change management, or process improvement.

 - Experience operating in a highly technical, AI- and autonomy-forward team environment.




SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES

 - Critical thinker, proactive and collaborative partner to engineering who prioritizes actions that drive efficiency at scale and takes pride in owning the work and continuously strive for iterative improvement.

 - Treats requirements as a discipline, not paperwork — precise, structured, and allergic to ambiguity.

 - Comfortable operating at the intersection of software, controls, and hardware that defines an autonomy stack.

 - Power-user mindset toward Jira; a steward of the workflow, not just a participant in it.

 - Proactive communicator who surfaces risk early rather than waiting to be asked.

 - Strong cross-functional facilitation skills serving as the liaison between Business, Product, and Engineering.




BENEFITS & PERKS

Our culture fosters collaboration, respect, and trust, empowering passionate people to do their best work. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career growth. In addition to an opportunity to take part in an innovative, collaborative and fast-growing business with a highly motivated and skilled team, we also take pride in taking care of our employees. Here are just a few ways that we show our appreciation:

 - We offer premium medical, dental, and vision coverage with zero paycheck premiums for you and your family

 - 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan to invest in your long-term retirement goals + Company match

 - Equity grants for new hires

 - Unlimited PTO

 - 11 Paid holidays

 - Extremely generous company holiday calendar, including a holiday hiatus in November, & December.

 - Generous Parental Leave

 - Military Leave for annual training or service requirements

 - FSA

 - DCFSA

 - HSA

 - Professional Development Opportunities

 - Access to One Medical https://www.onemedical.com/

 - Mental Health Resources: We provide free mental health resources 24/7 including therapy and more. Additional work-life services, such as free legal and financial support, are available to you as well.




GROWTH PATH AT NODA

This role sits at the center of NODA's growing Technical Program Management function, and strong performers can grow in one of three directions:

 - Senior TPM leadership. Progress into Staff and then Principal TPM, taking on ownership of the operating model across multiple engineering teams rather than a single team. At this level you're setting requirement management and Jira governance standards org-wide, managing a team of TPMs, and advising engineering and company leadership on program health and delivery risk.

 - Mission Lead. Move into a role embedded directly with operators and government/commercial customers, translating field feedback and mission needs into engineering requirements. This path trades internal ceremony ownership for direct customer relationship management, on-site deployments, and being the voice of the mission back into the engineering roadmap.

 - Product Management. Transition into a Product Manager role, moving from executing against defined requirements to defining the roadmap and prioritization strategy itself. This path leans on the requirement-writing and stakeholder-translation skills built in this role, extended into market and customer strategy, competitive positioning, and longer-horizon product bets.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER – NODA AI

Location: Austin, TX (Hybrid — minimum 3 days/week on-site preferred)
Travel: 15% or less
Clearance: U.S. Citizen with the ability and willingness to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance (sponsorship available)



About NODA

NODA is a veteran-owned, venture-backed technology company transforming how unmanned systems collaborate in complex, mission-critical environments. We develop next-generation software that enables autonomous orchestration of heterogeneous unmanned systems across air, sea, land, and space for defence, intelligence, and commercial customers. Joining NODA means working on high-impact systems that go from prototype to fielded capability.



About the Role

NODA AI is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the products and workflows that turn mission intent into executable plans for autonomous systems. This is a highly technical, customer-facing product role at the intersection of mission planning, command and control, autonomy, and real-world operations. Our users operate in environments where software must do more than be intuitive. It must help operators translate mission intent into executable plans, synchronize actions across systems and platforms, understand risks and constraints, and adapt as conditions change. You will bring a deep understanding of how operators plan and execute missions today and help define how those workflows evolve as autonomous and multi-domain systems become increasingly central to operations. We are looking for someone who understands mission planning software, command-and-control systems, and operational workflows, ideally through direct experience with systems such as Joint Mission Planning System (JMPS), FalconView, Portable Flight Planning Software (PFPS), other comparable DoD mission planning or C2 products, and commercial ground control stations such as QGroundControl.

This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role with significant product ownership. You will spend time with operators, work shoulder-to-shoulder with Engineering and Design, participate in field exercises and customer deployments, and see firsthand how the product performs in operational environments. You will serve as a voice of the operator, translating operator feedback, doctrine, TTPs, field observations, technical constraints and customer requirements into product strategy, intuitive workflows, and engineering priorities. A critical part of this role will be helping NODA AI evolve into a scalable multi-domain product platform. You will identify patterns across missions, customers, platforms, and integrations and determine what should become configurable, repeatable product capability, balancing immediate operational needs and customer commitments with the long-term architecture and integrity of the platform.

This role requires strong product instincts, technical fluency, operational awareness and the ability to bring structure and coordination to ambiguous, cross-functional problems. You will own meaningful product outcomes from discovery through development, field deployment, and iteration. You will help define what we build and why, make difficult prioritization decisions, and distinguish between what a customer asks for and the underlying problem the product should solve. Success requires deep user empathy, technical fluency, strong product and design judgment, and the ability to bring clarity to complex, ambiguous problems. You will partner closely with Engineering to deliver capabilities that reduce operator workload, accelerate decision-making, and give users confidence in the plans they execute when the mission matters.



What You'll Do

 - Facilitate the product strategy, roadmap, and requirements for NODA AI's mission planning software, translating mission needs into intuitive, operationally relevant product capabilities.

 - Act as the voice of the operator, working directly with warfighters, mission planners, and Government stakeholders to understand operational workflows, identify unmet needs, and translate insights into product direction.

 - Define and evolve workflows for mission creation, course-of-action development, planning, tasking, coordination, visualization, feasibility validation, execution, monitoring, and dynamic re-planning across autonomous and multi-domain systems.

 - Translate mission objectives, operator workflows, technical constraints, and customer requirements into clear product requirements, workflows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and development priorities.

 - Drive the transition from programs to scalable product capabilities, identifying patterns across customer engagements and defining the abstractions, configurations, workflows, and interfaces that turn one-off requirements into repeatable capabilities across customers and missions.

 - Partner closely with Engineering and Design through the full product lifecycle, from discovery and prototyping through development, integration, field deployment, validation, and iteration, delivering reliable and intuitive experiences that increase operator confidence.

 - Drive product decisions involving complex interactions between planning software, autonomy, command and control, communications, networking, sensors, payloads, platforms, and Ground Control Stations.

 - Evaluate integration and interoperability requirements with existing Government systems, mission planning tools, Ground Control Stations, data formats, interfaces, and operational workflows.

 - Participate directly in field exercises, demonstrations, integration events, testing, and customer deployments to observe product performance, validate workflows, and gather operator feedback firsthand.

 - Define and measure product success through planning speed, operator workload, feasibility validation, risk and constraint identification, mission-plan quality, successful execution, user adoption, operator feedback, and mission outcomes, using those insights to continuously improve the product.



Required Qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field

 - 7+ years of product management or technical product management experience, including ownership of complex, mission-critical software or integrated hardware/software products

 - Minimum 2 years of experience in a dedicated Product Manager role

 - U.S. Citizenship required due to ITAR regulations & the ability to obtain and maintain a Department of Defense (DoD) security clearance

 - Demonstrated success delivering and scaling field-deployed, mission-critical, or operationally complex software products

 - Track record of shipping products, not just features, with end-to-end ownership from user research and product strategy through design, development, field deployment, adoption, and iteration, including making difficult decisions about what not to build

 - Direct knowledge of military mission planning and execution workflows, gained through product, engineering, program, or operational experience

 - Hands-on familiarity with one or more mission planning environments such as JMPS, FalconView, PFPS, Ground Control Station software, or comparable DoD planning and execution tools

 - Strong understanding of the relationship between mission planning, command and control, platform tasking, autonomous behaviors, and mission execution

 - Exceptional product discovery and research instincts, with demonstrated ability to learn complex domains through direct user engagement, workflow observation, technical investigation, doctrine, and operational context and synthesize findings into product decisions

 - Strong technical fluency and systems-level thinking. You do not need to write the code, but you must understand complex software systems deeply enough to partner with Engineering on architecture, interfaces, dependencies, feasibility, and technical tradeoffs

 - Demonstrated ability to translate complex operational and customer requirements into clear product requirements and actionable priorities for engineering teams

 - Strong product judgment, including the ability to distinguish between customer requests, underlying user problems, program-specific requirements, and scalable product capabilities

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to write a clear product brief, lead a productive design or product review, and communicate strategy and tradeoffs to engineers, operators, Government customers, program leadership, and executives

 - Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites, test events, demonstrations, exercises, and field deployments as required



Preferred Qualifications

 - MBA or Technical Graduate Degree

 - Active DoD security clearance

 - Prior Military highly desirable; specifically aviation, UAS, C2, or related operational background.

 - Prior work in a fast-moving defense technology, autonomy, robotics, or dual-use technology company

 - Direct operational experience using JMPS, FalconView, PFPS, or similar mission planning software

 - Hands-on experience with Ground Control Stations (GCS) for unmanned aircraft, ground vehicles, maritime systems, or other autonomous platforms

 - Product or operational background with autonomous systems, robotics, unmanned systems, AI/ML, command-and-control software, or multi-domain operations

 - Background integrating software with sensors, payloads, vehicles, communications systems, edge compute, or other hardware platforms

 - Background supporting Government test events, demonstrations, exercises, operational evaluations, or field deployments

 - Direct interaction with DoD acquisition organizations, program offices, operational units, or intelligence community customers

 - Prior ownership of a 0-to-1 product or major new product capability in a technically complex environment



Skills & Attributes

 - Ability to make effective prioritization decisions when balancing user needs, technical feasibility, resource constraints, customer commitments, program requirements, and long-term product architecture.

 - Operator obsessed: You want to understand how users actually plan and execute missions, not simply what a requirements document says they do.

 - Strong product judgment: You can separate a customer request from the underlying user problem and determine whether the right answer is a new feature, a different workflow, an integration or something we should not build.

 - Product-minded, not program-driven: You recognize patterns across customer requirements and build scalable capabilities rather than accumulating one-off solutions.

 - Technically credible: You can go deep enough with engineers to understand system constraints, architecture, integrations, dependencies, and technical tradeoffs without needing to be the person writing the code.

 - Mission-oriented: You evaluate product decisions based on whether they make the operator more capable and the mission more successful.

 - Strategic and execution-focused: You can maintain a long-term product vision while making practical decisions about what needs to ship now.

 - Decisive: You are comfortable making difficult prioritization decisions with imperfect information and clearly communicating the reasoning and tradeoffs behind them.

 - Hands-on: You are willing to sit with users, test workflows, participate in field events, troubleshoot alongside engineers, and see firsthand how the product performs.

 - High ownership: You take responsibility for product outcomes from initial discovery through field deployment, adoption, and iteration.

 - Clear communicator: You can translate between operators, engineers, program teams, Government stakeholders, and executives without losing the substance of the problem.

 - Comfortable in ambiguity: You create structure where requirements are evolving, technology is advancing quickly, and the right product solution is not immediately obvious.

Our culture fosters collaboration, respect, and trust, empowering passionate people to do their best work. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career growth. In addition to an opportunity to take part in an innovative, collaborative and fast-growing business with a highly motivated and skilled team, we also take pride in taking care of our employees. Here are just a few ways that we show our appreciation:
